text:
jamie: Quick heads-up — planning to cut v3.2.0 today. Targeting a 4pm PT cutoff for merges into release/main. Please hold all non-blocking PRs and add a changelog entry if your change affects public behavior.

sam: ACK. Which branch should feature PRs target after cutoff?

jamie: After cutoff, branch off release/main-staging for patches. No direct pushes to main please.

rita: CI queue is a bit backed up. We're seeing a recurring flaky in `tests/e2e/session_store.test.js` on linux-gpu runners. Failing about 3/20 runs.

cleo: Seen the same locally on M1 boxes but with different error — timeout waiting for websocket. I filed a minimal repro in #support but can paste logs here if helpful.

sam: Can someone rerun the flaky job so we have a current trace? I don't want to gate the whole release on a flaky test if we can patch it quickly.

deploy-bot: ci:build #2871 failed on linux-gpu — tests/e2e/session_store.test.js — see https://ci.internal/2871 

mike: I kicked a rerun for #2871. If it flakes again, let's quarantine the test with `@flaky` label and skip under GPU runners until we fix.

rita: Rerun came back green. Looks like transient. I'll open a ticket to add a retry decorator in the test harness and add better timeouts.

cleo: For changelog: use the template in docs/changelogs/README.md. Small reminder: include the public-facing description and any migration steps.

jamie: Thanks — two quick asks before cutoff: (1) ping me your PR numbers in this thread if you need merges during the window, (2) ensure changelog entry + one-line release-note in the PR body.

sam: PRs: #4023 (metrics opt-in), #4030 (embed cache tweak). Both have changelog entries. Can you merge after quick CI check? :eyes:

jamie: I'll watch CI for those. If green, I'll merge up to 15 minutes before cutoff.

rita: Also, bumping the package version — use `v3.2.0-rc1` for the initial tag, then `v3.2.0` on publish. Command I run: ```git tag -a v3.2.0-rc1 -m "v3.2.0 rc1"
git push origin v3.2.0-rc1```

cleo: Is there a checklist I can follow for release QA?

jamie: Yep — checklist: sanity smoke (api health, simple generation), smoke ingest for embeddings, run key perf benchmark, quick canary on dedicated pool. I'll paste it in a gist after I get a minute.

mike: Heads-up: dedicated infra autoscaler will do a rolling restart during the release window if we exceed burst capacity. Keep an eye on latency graphs around the time we promote.

sam: Noted. If anyone sees latency regressions, @mike and @rita are on call for infra.

cleo: One last thing — QA will try an exploratory session at 3:30pm PT. If anyone needs to freeze merges earlier for their testing, shout now.

jamie: Great. If no objections, we hold merges to main until post-cutoff and use release/main-staging for any emergency patches. I'll post the final go/no-go at 3:55pm PT. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: release:note Generated draft release notes for v3.2.0-rc1 at https://releases.internal/v3.2.0-rc1/draft 

rita: Filing infra follow-up: ticket INFRA-918 for flaky e2e on linux-gpu.

sam: Thanks all — pinged with PRs. Good luck! :rocket:
